kept.statement: Raw source-oracle agreement must not become a named-profile suite-pass or hardware-accuracy claim while baseline decision O1 remains open.
The deterministic timer phase, tie policy and minimal request/sleep seam must not be represented as calibrated hardware, working Suzy or firmware/cartridge boot evidence.

stage2.dropped_routine: Execution/completion, bounds, stale state and mismatch controls belong to edge coverage and code review.
stage2.canon_referral: Bounds/deserialization/privacy/rights handling is covered by secure-phase and existing hygiene/provenance checks, not minted as a new generic prohibition.
